title: Practice Lab: Defender GPO Deployment, CrowdStrike API & BitLocker

steps.title: Onboard Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
steps.instruction: Execute PowerShell commands to verify Defender services ('WinDefend' and 'Sense') and verify real-time cloud protection status.
steps.hint: Run Get-Service -Name WinDefend, Sense and Get-MpPreference in PowerShell.

steps.title: Configure CrowdStrike Falcon Host Auto-Isolation API
steps.instruction: Simulate calling CrowdStrike Falcon REST API to automatically isolate a compromised host upon detecting critical ransomware behavior.
steps.hint: Send POST request to CrowdStrike device action endpoint /devices/entities/host-actions/v1.

steps.title: Verify BitLocker XTS-AES Encryption via Intune
steps.instruction: Check BitLocker drive encryption status on OS volume C: and ensure recovery keys are backed up to Active Directory / Azure AD.
